applies_to: Each AWS account using Amazon EC2. Region-Level SLA (instances across 2+ AZs) = 99.99%; Instance-Level SLA (single instance) = 99.5%. Tiers below are Region-Level.
claim_deadline: By the end of the second billing cycle after the incident
how_to_claim: Open a case in AWS Support Center. Subject: 'Amazon Compute SLA Credit Request – Region-Level Claim' (or Instance-Level Claim); include dates/times/region of each incident, EC2 resource IDs, and request logs. Credit is % of monthly EC2 bill in affected region, applied to future EC2 payments; only issued if > $1.

applies_to: All Twilio-branded APIs + SendGrid Mail Send API (standard). 99.99% threshold if customer bought Twilio Enterprise Edition (or Administration Edition before Oct 24, 2024). Segment and Flex Critical Scenarios have separate SLAs.
uptime_commitment: 99.95% monthly API availability (99.99% for Enterprise Edition)
claim_deadline: Within 30 days from the last day of the affected calendar month
how_to_claim: Support ticket at https://help.twilio.com (SendGrid: support.sendgrid.com) with subject 'SLA Claim', dates/times of unavailability per status.twilio.com, and documentation. Credit = 10% of fees for affected APIs that month (excl. taxes/carrier fees), applied to future charges, not refunds.

applies_to: Core Services on a Datadog Order (Master Subscription Agreement)
claim_deadline: N/A (no service credits). Termination right arises after 2 consecutive months below 99.8%, exercisable in the following calendar month by written notice.
how_to_claim: NO SERVICE CREDITS. Sole remedy: terminate the affected Core Service commitment and receive a pro-rated refund of unused prepaid amounts. Availability info can be requested via a Support request.

uptime_commitment: No numeric uptime published on current public page; 'commercially reasonable efforts' to be available 24/7 (effective July 11, 2024)
how_to_claim: No public credit schedule or claim process on the current public SLA page. Any credit terms would be in the customer's own contract (likely Enterprise / negotiated).

applies_to: Enterprise plan only (Enterprise Service Level Agreement). Covers content-serving platform; excludes API and CLI.
claim_deadline: Notify Vercel in writing within 30 days of becoming eligible for a credit
how_to_claim: Written notice to Vercel with log files showing the Unscheduled Downtime and its date/time. Credits capped at 50% of monthly fee, applied to future fees within 60 days of request.

applies_to: GitHub Enterprise Cloud: git Operations, Issues, Pages, Pull Requests, Webhooks, and API requests to these. Measured per calendar quarter.
claim_deadline: Written request within 30 days of the end of the Applicable Period (calendar quarter)
how_to_claim: Written request to GitHub Support (or Microsoft support ticket if bought through Microsoft). Credit is refund or account credit, not cash; max 90 days of paid service per quarter; invoices must be paid.
